name: 33556 · Odessa, FL
findings: ZIP 33556 (Odessa) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33556 (Odessa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
